ledger.x: 18 January 1871: the German Empire is founded.
January 1871: the war with the republic goes on under the new Empire.
28 January 1871: truce.
1871: German troops hold parts of France as a guarantee.
10 May 1871: Alsace-Lorraine passes to Germany.
September 1873: the last German troops leave France.
1884: German New Guinea.
April 1884: the first colony.
October 1885: the Marshall Islands.
1888: Nauru. 'In 1888, Germany ended the civil war on Nauru and annexed the island.'
1895: concessions at Tientsin and Hankow.
November 1897: Jiaozhou Bay.
1899: the Carolines, Marianas and Palau.
1899: German Samoa.
Late 1914: Germany holds the north-east of France.
1914: the Russian army invades East Prussia.
1914: the invasion fails.
1914: Nauru. 'Australia later seized Nauru'.
2 August 1914: Germany occupies Luxembourg.
4 August 1914: Germany invades and occupies Belgium.
August-September 1914: the Pacific colonies fall.
September 1914: 'Australian troops occupied German New Guinea the following month' (after the invasion of Samoa in August).
October 1914: 'Japanese troops occupied the German possessions in Micronesia in October 1914'.
October 1914: 'Japanese troops occupied the German possessions in Micronesia in October 1914' (the Marshall Islands among them).
November 1914: Jiaozhou Bay.
Autumn 1915: Ober Ost and the Government General of Warsaw.
1917: Ober Ost grows.
1917: the Tianjin concession is lost; the colonies page gives no loss date ('The source does not state a loss date or outcome').
March 1917: the Tsar falls.
March 1917: the same ground is now Russian Republic land under German occupation; Ober Ost was reorganised 'In March 1917... into three provinces: Kurland, Litauen, and Bialystok-Grodno'.
February-April 1917: the German armies withdraw to the Hindenburg Line.
Spring 1918: the offensive in the west retakes ground.
9 February 1918: the Central Powers sign a peace with Ukraine.
18 February 1918: Operation Faustschlag.
11 November 1918: the armistice.
11 November 1918: the armistice ends the occupation of Belgium.
November 1918: the occupation of Luxembourg ends with the armistice.
13 November 1918: Brest-Litovsk annulled.
November 1918: Ober Ost ends.
November 1918: the 1917 conquests of Ober Ost end with the armistice and the withdrawal.
November 1918: the Rada's German backing ends with the armistice and the annulment of the treaty on 13 November 1918.
9 November 1918: the colonies pass out of the Empire's hands.
9 November 1918: the Empire ends.

wars.name: Franco-Prussian War
wars.outcome: German victory: truce 28 January 1871; Treaty of Frankfurt 10 May 1871 gave Germany Alsace-Lorraine (about 14,470 km2) and a 5-billion-franc indemnity; German troops left France in September 1873.

wars.name: World War I
wars.outcome: Germany occupied Luxembourg (2 August 1914), Belgium (from 4 August 1914), north-eastern France and, from 1915, Russian Poland and Ober Ost; the armistice of 11 November 1918 followed the republic's proclamation on 9 November.

wars.name: Treaty of Brest-Litovsk and the German offensive in the east
wars.outcome: Signed 3 March 1918 after Faustschlag (from 18 February); Russia gave up Poland, the Baltic, Belarus and Ukraine; the treaty was annulled on 13 November 1918.

certainty.note: The German frontier is a treaty or administrative line (Treaty of Frankfurt for Alsace-Lorraine); the colonies' inland frontiers and the 1871-1873 occupation zone are soft.
Occupation lines in Belgium, France, Poland, the Baltic and Ukraine moved with the front; Germany's own frontier is sharp.
